message.content: {"answer":"Important symbols to Caroline include a necklace with a cross and a heart given by her grandmother representing love, faith, and strength; a hand-painted bowl symbolizing art and self-expression; the rainbow flag mural symbolizing courage, strength, freedom, and pride of the trans community; a stained glass window representing the journey of acceptance and growth; and her own art which expresses her transgender experience and self-acceptance.
